## Overview

`Antigravity IDE` `2.8.0` (`2.8.0-6733682917113856`, a separate Code OSS `1.107.0` product line distinct from standalone Electron `antigravity-hub`) follows the exact same `"agy-only"` change pattern observed in [IDE 2.7.0](2026-11-11_ide-2.7.0.md). Across all three official desktop platforms (`darwin-arm`, `linux-x64`, `windows-x64`), **100% of substantive application code changes reside in `3` files inside `extensions/agy/` (`1.11.0` → `1.12.0`, `+66.9` KB total)**—alongside a macOS-only rebuild of `2` MSAL native binaries inside `extensions/microsoft-authentication/dist/`. The Code OSS shell (`out/`), standalone `jetskiAgent` renderer (`11.8 MB`), inline `351`-method `LanguageServerService` protobuf descriptor, `extensions/agy/dist/extension.js` host bundle, `node_modules/`, and `agy --hub` spawn scaffolding are **completely frozen for a third consecutive release** (`2.6.0` → `2.7.0` → `2.8.0`), differing only in trailing 37-byte sourcemap commit hashes and the `5` metadata keys in `product.json`.

On `darwin-arm`, `diff -rq` on `extensions/` reports **`56` differing files = `51` sourcemap-only + `5` substantive**:

|---|---|---|
| `extensions/agy/vscode/extension.js` | `4,480,779` → `4,533,239` B (**`+52,460` B**) | All backend-management logic additions (`+74` new string literals, `0` deleted) |
| `extensions/agy/bridge.js` | `1,938,305` → `1,952,437` B (**`+14,132` B**) | Synchronized iframe protobuf runtime expansion (`+26` schemas: `2,137` → `2,163`) |
| `extensions/agy/package.json` | `17,536` → `18,196` B (`+660` B) | Manifest `1.11.0` → `1.12.0` (`+1` command, `+1` keybinding, `+1` setting) |
| `extensions/microsoft-authentication/dist/libmsalruntime.dylib` | `6,589,440` B (same size, rebuilt bytes) | MSAL native runtime rebuild (**macOS-only**; Linux & Windows MSAL files have zero diff) |
| `extensions/microsoft-authentication/dist/msal-node-runtime.node` | `345,008` B (same size, rebuilt bytes) | Same as above (**macOS-only**) |

- **Manifest Diff (`extensions/agy/package.json`, `1.11.0` → `1.12.0`)**:
  - **Commands (`33` → `34`)**: Sole addition is `antigravity.dynamic.conversationView.findInConversation` (a `dynamic.*` forwarding command; the find-in-conversation UI implementation lives in the agent webview, with `0` implementation symbols in the extension bundle).
  - **Keybindings (`20` → `21`)**: Sole addition binds `ctrl+f` (`cmd+f` on macOS) to `antigravity.dynamic.conversationView.findInConversation` with `when`: `focusedView == 'antigravity.panel' || antigravity.chatFocused && !editorFocus && !terminalFocus && !listFocus && !inputFocus`.
  - **Configuration (`16` → `17`)**: Sole addition is `antigravity.caCertificates` (custom root CA certificates).
  - `submenus` (`2`), `views` (`1`), `viewsContainers` (`1`), `customEditors` (`2`), and `menus` (`10`) are byte-identical.
- **Backend Management & Auth Additions in `vscode/extension.js` (`+52,460` B; `+74` New String Literals, `0` Deleted)**:
  - **Periodic Background Update Checks & Restart Prompt**: Adds `ANTIGRAVITY_PERIODIC_UPDATE_CHECK_INTERVAL_MS`, `ANTIGRAVITY_STALE_SERVER_UPGRADE_PROMPT_MS`, `"Restart Agent Server"`, and telemetry event `google.antigravity.vscode.extension.server.upgrade_prompt`.
  - **Update / Install Decision Telemetry Codes (`11` Codes + Dialog States)**: Adds `periodic_background`, `startup_background`, `check_deferred`, `deferred`, `throttled`, `manifest_unreachable`, **`downgrade_skipped`**, **`same_version_rebuild`**, `staged_promoted`, `installed`, and `not_applicable` (alongside `cancelled` / `dismissed`)—backing non-blocking startup checks, multi-window anti-downgrade guards, and recovery-timeout re-download protection.
  - **Remote Sign-In Port Forwarding & Auth-Code Fallback**:
    - Adds a new direct Connect-RPC call **`POST …/LanguageServerService/SwitchLoginToAuthCode`** (`0` → `1`, with `x-codeium-csrf-token` references `1` → `2`). **Boundary note**: `SwitchLoginToAuthCode` is **absent from the frozen `351`-method `out/main.js` protobuf descriptor** (`0` descriptor hits vs. `5` for `GetAuthStatus`); it targets the runtime-downloaded `agy` CLI backend, whose implementation at `CL 1025045237` cannot be statically proven from the IDE package.
    - Adds OOB/tunnel literals `ANTIGRAVITY_REMOTE_OOB_AUTH` (`×5`), `redirect_uri`, `tunneled`, `tunnel_unavailable`, `ANTIGRAVITY_SERVER_CSRF_TOKEN`, `forward` (`19` → `21`), and `6` remote-target identifiers (`ssh-remote`, `dev-container`, `attached-container`, `cloud-shell`, `cloud-workstations`, `codespaces`).
  - **Custom Root CA Certificates & Enterprise Proxy Stack**: Adds `antigravity.caCertificates`, dual-prefix certificate settings `agent.additionalTrustedCertificates` and `geminicodeassist.agent.additionalTrustedCertificates`, environment variables `AGY_CA_CERT`, `AGY_LLM_GATEWAY_CA_CERT`, `AGY_LLM_GATEWAY_PROXY_URL`, `AGY_PROXY_STRICT_SSL`, `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` (`4` → `5`), `NODE_USE_SYSTEM_CA`, `SSL_CERT_FILE`, VS Code settings `http.proxy`, `http.noProxy`, `http.proxyStrictSSL`, `proxySupport`, and the full proxy env family (`HTTP_PROXY`/`http_proxy`, `HTTPS_PROXY`/`https_proxy`, `ALL_PROXY`/`all_proxy`, `NO_PROXY`/`no_proxy`).

## Frozen Subsystems (Three-Release Zero-Diff Base)

After stripping trailing `/*# sourceMappingURL=... */` and `//# sourceMappingURL=` comments:

1. **`out/` Code OSS Base**: Exactly `27` differing files (`24` JS + `3` CSS) across `darwin-arm`, `linux-x64`, and `windows-x64`; **27/27 differ solely by the trailing sourcemap commit hash** (`71bedb45…` → `8dc5315a…`) and are byte-identical once stripped. Native MCP/editor-host registrations, auto-updater feed construction (`antigravity-ide-auto-updater…`), and workbench logic are unchanged.
2. **`out/jetskiAgent/` Renderer**: `out/jetskiAgent/main.js` (`11,837,046` B, identical size across `2.6.0`/`2.7.0`/`2.8.0`) retains stripped SHA-256 `b674d91f5d3ed2a5…`—**three consecutive releases with zero substantive code change**. `jetskiAgent.js`, `workbench.js`, and `main.css` are likewise sourcemap-only; entry HTML, CSP, and window lifecycle are unchanged.
3. **On-Demand LS Model & Frozen Connect-RPC Descriptor**: Still ships zero bundled `language_server` binary. The inline base64 `language_server.proto` `FileDescriptorProto` extracted from `2.8.0` `out/main.js` is `181,134` chars (`SHA-256 a9f7b6f4e20c3cc9…`, identical across `2.6.0`/`2.7.0`/`2.8.0`), declaring `exa.language_server_pb.LanguageServerService` with **`351` methods**—frozen for three consecutive releases.
4. **`extensions/agy/dist/extension.js`**: `1,462,852` B (unchanged size), differing solely in `37` trailing sourcemap commit-hash bytes.
5. **`node_modules/`**: `2,628` differing files on `darwin-arm` with `0` added or removed entries (spot-checked as trailing sourcemap comments only; package list and versions unchanged).
6. **Hub Spawn Mechanics & Metadata**: Identical identifier counts (`2.7.0` = `2.8.0`) for `--hub-port` (`×1`), `CDE_PREINSTALLED_BINARY_PATH` (`×3`), `promoteBinarySafely` (`×1`), `healthz` (`×4`), `canRetryPortCollision` (`×3`), `PortCollision` (`×5`), `agy.version.json` (`×1`), and `GetAuthStatus`/`hasValidAuth` (`×1` each); `package.json.patch` (`4,556` B, `isAntigravityIde` hunk) and the `73` non-version keys in `product.json` (including placeholder `updateUrl: "https://example.com"`) are byte-identical.

## Official Changelog Reconciliation (`IDE v2.8.0`, `2026-11-19`)

Because Antigravity IDE loads its Agent UI via a remote `agy` webview and runs its backend via a runtime-downloaded `agy` CLI (`antigravity-cli-auto-updater`), official entries implemented inside either remote component can at most leave call-site, entry-point, or configuration footprints inside the static IDE installer:

| Official Entry (`v2.8.0`: `7` Improvements + `5` Fixes) | Static Package Evidence | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| Background periodic update checks + restart prompt when ready | `ANTIGRAVITY_PERIODIC_UPDATE_CHECK_INTERVAL_MS`, `ANTIGRAVITY_STALE_SERVER_UPGRADE_PROMPT_MS`, `"Restart Agent Server"`, `upgrade_prompt` telemetry | **Corroborated in package (`extensions/agy`)** |
| Instant startup with already-installed backend; activation unblocked by release checks | `startup_background`, `check_deferred` decision telemetry codes | **Corroborated via static cues** (runtime timing not executed) |
| Remote sign-in port forwarding + auth-code fallback | Direct `SwitchLoginToAuthCode` call (outside frozen descriptor), `forward` `+2`, `ANTIGRAVITY_REMOTE_OOB_AUTH`, `redirect_uri`, `tunneled`/`tunnel_unavailable`, `6` remote-target identifiers | **Call site corroborated in package; LS-side implementation points to runtime `agy` CLI (`CL 1025045237`), not statically provable** |
| Custom root CA certificates & proxy support for sign-in | `antigravity.caCertificates` setting + CA/proxy env & VS Code config family (`AGY_*`/`NODE_*`/`SSL_CERT_FILE`/`http.proxy*`/`geminicodeassist` dual-prefix) | **Corroborated in package** |
| Find-in-conversation shortcut when Agent panel is focused | Manifest command + `ctrl+f`/`cmd+f` keybinding (`when` clause matches description); `0` search UI symbols in bundle | **Entry point corroborated; UI resides in webview** |
| Semantic visually hidden headings for conversation messages (screen readers) | `aria` references `113` → `117` (`+4`) in `extension.js`; no heading entities | **Weak circumstantial cue; UI resides in webview** |
| Backend readiness timeout increased `30s` → `60s` | `0` delta for `30_000`/`60_000`/`readiness` constants in package | **Outside static package — likely in runtime `agy` CLI** |
| Windows logoff/shutdown recovery infinite-loop fix | `0` `logoff`/`shutdown` literals; `out/` base completely frozen | **Outside static package surface** (runtime `agy` / webview) |
| Multi-window shared-channel anti-downgrade guard | `downgrade_skipped`, `same_version_rebuild` decision telemetry codes | **Corroborated in package (`extensions/agy`)** |
| Fix for recovery timeout clearing metadata and triggering repeated downloads | Same install-decision telemetry code family (`check_deferred`, `staged_promoted`, etc.) | **Corroborated via static cues** |
| Windows multi-window task-notification focus fix | `out/` frozen; no matching entity in `agy` or `bridge.js` | **Outside static package surface** |
| Other minor UI fixes | — | **Not individually mappable statically** |

## Cross-Platform Parity, Signature Scope & Limitations

- **Three-Platform Parity**: `out/` differs in exactly `27` sourcemap-only files on all three platforms. `extensions/` differs in `56` files on `darwin-arm` vs. `54` on `linux-x64` and `54` on `windows-x64`—the `2`-file delta is exclusively macOS's `libmsalruntime.dylib` and `msal-node-runtime.node` rebuilds. Inside `extensions/agy/` (`12` files; darwin tree hash `e042bae0…` → `e10c034a…`), `vscode/extension.js` and `bridge.js` are byte-identical between `darwin-arm` and `linux-x64` while `windows-x64` is a pure CRLF variant (`28,084` CR lines, byte-identical to `darwin-arm` after CRLF normalization); `package.json` and `dist/extension.js` are byte-identical across all three platforms.
- **Platform Metadata Carriers**: `product.json` changes in the same `5` keys (`ideVersion`, `commit`, `date`, `languageServerCL`, `checksums`); `darwin-arm` `Info.plist` updates `CFBundleShortVersionString`/`CFBundleVersion` to `2.8.0` (`com.google.antigravity-ide`); `windows-x64` Inno Setup 6.x payload (`code$GetDestDir`) unpacks cleanly with UTF-16LE `FileVersion`/`ProductVersion` `2.8.0` at PE offset `209,797,224` (identical offset to `2.6.0`/`2.7.0`) and `23` positive `6733682917113856` build-ID hits.
- **Verification Scope & Limitations**: Read-only static analysis only (target apps were never executed). `darwin-arm` was the primary full-diff axis, while `linux-x64` and `windows-x64` were cross-checked by diff counts, sampling, and key-file hashes rather than exhaustive three-way file-by-file comparisons across `node_modules/`; Windows Inno Setup installer script metadata (`AppId`/tasks) was not extracted. macOS signature inspection verified only `_CodeSignature/CodeResources` presence and `Info.plist` version (`2.8.0`) without `codesign` or notarization validation. Runtime-downloaded `agy` CLI binaries, remotely loaded webview resources, and full-user rollout status cannot be verified statically from the IDE installers.
